create_SpotSkillManager: create a SpotSkillManager instance to control a Spot robot with navigation, pick, and place skills
run_nav_skill: run the nav skill to navigate Spot to a named waypoint or x,y,theta coordinates
run_pick_skill: run the pick skill to grasp a named object with optional pose estimation and force control
run_place_skill: run the place skill to place an object at a named waypoint or x,y,z coordinates
run_dock_skill: run the dock skill to navigate Spot to its charging dock and shut down
